item.content:encoded:
How about international stuff like:

Guest appearance - Write five articles with one or more characters from another language Branch. (Maybe only for Foundation Staff and no Author Avatars?)

Attack from outside! – Write five articles for one or more Groups of Interest from another language Branch.

A visit from another world – Write five articles for one or more canons from another language Branch.

… and non INT stuff:

Hey, I know that one! – Write an article about a minor Groups of Interest or person who has received little attention for some time or has no tag now.

Just a second. They did what?! – Write three articles about a situation where two groups or people who would otherwise never work together do just that. Bonus points the crazier it is. Minus points if they do it under a trick like brainwashing or unknowingly.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Do you plan on adding some of the ones on Roget's page? Specifically:

  • Friend Of The People — Take part in 5 writing collaborations. You must be a full co-author, not just a contributor.
  • Thousandaire — Entered into any of the X000 contests (i.e. SCP-1000, SCP-2000, SCP-3000, etc.)
  • Sharpshooter — As an author of at least 10 articles on the wiki, have an average net upvote rating for your body of work that is at least +100

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
This looks fun! Off the top of my head, a few ideas for more badges:

  • Tall Tales — Published ten tales on the wiki. Individual chapters count, if they are their own pages.
  • Containment Specialist: Safe/Euclid/Keter/Thaumiel/Explained — Separate badges in each object class for posting ten SCPs at that level.
  • Canonized — Authored or co-authored a new canon.
  • Thank You For Your Cooperation — co-authored five (or 10?) pages with at least five (or 10?) different people.
